statement: A VD instance is an ordered entry-log; new entries append; no in-place edits.
A VD instance is a named authority object consisting of an identifier and an entry-log.
notes: Promote to LOCKED when naming/authority semantics are finalized.

statement: Each entry is (w, ?) with w and ? both strings.
The primitive object is the entry-log, not a single-valued Strings?Strings map; lookup may be multi-valued unless a policy is specified.
Stage-n state D^(n) is obtained by replaying entries E0..En under the instance’s evaluation conventions (including tokenization).
notes: May need a frozen-stage convention for Head(s).

statement: A word w is previously defined at stage n iff there exists k<n with head(E_k)=w as a string.
Each VD instance specifies a deterministic tokenization TOK with minimum guarantees: no substring matching; delimiter discipline; escaping mechanism.
notes: Concrete tokenizer profiles TBD; must respect notation rules.

statement: Within a given VD instance, headword matching is evaluated relative to its chosen TOK.
notes: May become LOCKED once TOK profiles are finalized.

statement: Given stage-n headword set W^(n) and definition string s, Head^(n)(s) is the set of h in W^(n) that occur as tokens in s under TOK.
notes: Needs robust token/notation handling; ignores words-inside-words.

statement: If headword occurrences in s (reading order) are h_{i1}..h_{ik}, then s decomposes as ?0 h_{i1} ?1 ... h_{ik} ?k.
Define Res_s(x1..xm) by replacing each headword occurrence in s with a placeholder variable for its unique headword, preserving the ?-segments.
notes: Formal placeholder indexing ? to be referenced.

statement: Res_s(h1..hm) reconstructs s (up to tokenization/spacing conventions).
notes: If TOK normalizes spacing, define equivalence accordingly.

statement: A definition string s is meaningfully defined iff Head(s)=? (equivalently Res_s is 0-ary / constant).
notes: Used as grounding target for validity.

statement: Two strings are residue-equal up to renaming if their residue functions match after a permutation of placeholders.
notes: Optional equality notion; not required for validity.

statement: A physical law is identified structurally as a triplet relation among three entries; the indices need not be consecutive.
notes: Requires a formal Triplet(i,j,k) predicate (to be supplied by you).

statement: A recognised triplet designates one Anchor (November) term and two Cyclic (Winter) terms.
notes: Role assignment rules depend on recognition definition.

statement: A standard presentation is the 3-cycle schema: Anc:=f(C1,C2), C1:=f(Anc,C2), C2:=f(Anc,C1) for a shared connective pattern f.
notes: Keep as bench until recognition predicate is formalized.

statement: A headword may serve as the Anchor (November) term for at most one law triplet in a VD instance.
notes: Active constraint; promote to LOCKED once fully endorsed.

statement: A VD instance is Valid iff every recognised law-triplet’s Anchor term traces back to at least one meaningfully-defined (headword-free) definition string.
Forward-reference bans may be enforced in an optional strict mode but are not VD-Core validity constraints.
notes: You corrected this: cannot be a core validity rule.

statement: A previously proposed rule required cyclic terms to be introduced simultaneously (often as consecutive entries) within a triplet; not enforced in VD-Core.
notes: Bench until/if you want a stricter mode.

statement: Net/aggregate terms must not imply causal source attribution.

short_name: Do not infer interaction from kinematics
statement: Interaction is not inferred from kinematics alone; it must be represented.
Permit irreducible complexity only in recognition predicates; downstream should be mechanical.
Use explicit bridge/connector words to avoid smuggling intuition.
Function/predicate arguments should appear in the headword to avoid hidden free variables.
Use triplets for commitments; use meaningfully-defined entries for execution semantics.
Track a dependency metric (degree of law) as a management aid.
Maintain explicit bookkeeping over November words.
Do not over-define; interpretability is assumed.
Separate whether something exists from whether it is active/contributing now.

short_name: Avoid causal inference from net quantities
statement: Do not infer causes from net quantities without explicit structure.
System boundaries must be explicit for action–reaction discussions.
